title: ASC 606 Milestone Noncash Consideration - DTCC / Canton Coin Arrangement
conclusionSummary: Analyzes the DTCC/Canton 10,000,000 Canton Coin milestone arrangement (M1 press release 2M; M2 go-live 6M; M3 volume threshold 2M). Concludes: (1) the coin is not transferred at signing but is unminted and committee-gated, so DTCC has no asset or control at inception; (2) the arrangement is noncash consideration for services rendered to the network; (3) fair value is measured at each Accountability Committee approval/mint date, not fixed at inception; (4) at the referenced Level 3 fair value of 0.0033 USD/CC the total earnable consideration is 33,000 USD, recognized milestone-by-milestone. Illustrative data; two judgments and the referenced fair value are reviewRequired.
